title.zh: 将俗称吉普车的机动车辆由汽车重新归类为卡车，以适用销售税征收与收取的法案
title.en: An Act Classifying as a Truck Instead of as an Automobile the Motor Vehicle Popularly Known as Jeep, for the Purposes of the Imposition and Collection of the Sales Tax
title.orig: An Act Classifying as a Truck Instead of as an Automobile the Motor Vehicle Popularly Known as Jeep, for the Purposes of the Imposition and Collection of the Sales Tax
title.vi: Đạo luật phân loại phương tiện cơ giới phổ biến với tên gọi Jeep là xe tải thay vì ô tô nhằm mục đích áp dụng và thu thuế bán hàng
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดประเภทยานพาหนะกลไกที่รู้จักกันโดยทั่วไปในชื่อจี๊ปให้เป็นรถบรรทุกแทนรถยนต์เพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ในการเรียกเก็บและจัดเก็บภาษีการขาย
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengklasifikasikan Kendaraan Bermotor yang Umum Dikenal Sebagai Jeep sebagai Truk Alih-alih Mobil, untuk Tujuan Pembebanan dan Pengumpulan Pajak Penjualan
title.ms: Akta Mengkelaskan Kenderaan Bermotor yang Secara Umum Dikenali Sebagai Jeep sebagai Lori dan Bukan Kereta, bagi Tujuan Pemungutan dan Pengutipan Cukai Jualan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1188_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: For purposes of the imposition and collection of the sales tax, the motor vehicle technically denominated "one-fourth ton truck, four by four" and popularly known as the jeep, is hereby classified as a truck, and every original sale, barter, exchange or similar transaction involving the transfer of ownership of, or title to, said motor vehicle shall be subject to the payment of the tax provided for in section one hundred eighty-six of the National Internal Revenue Code, as amended.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1954.
